home.why1: Regular tuition for Tamil Nadu State Board and CBSE

about.title: About us
about.p1: Radiance Academy coaches students in their regular academics through tuition for both the Tamil Nadu State Board and CBSE syllabus.
about.p2: Alongside school tuition we run spoken English courses, career guidance and coaching for NEET, JEE, IELTS, TNPSC and SSC exams.
about.p3: Our aim is simple: help every student understand concepts deeply and prepare with confidence.
